Privacy architecture

Imported files are read with browser File APIs, processed in a Web Worker, and exported with Blob URLs. They are not transmitted. The application has no analytics, account, OAuth, telemetry, remote fonts, runtime CDN, or AI API. Its CSP blocks all outbound connections with connect-src 'none'.

Limitations: the browser downloads the application itself from its host. Browser extensions, a compromised device, or a modified host build remain outside this application’s trust boundary. Verify release checksums or self-host for higher assurance.
